proof_scope: Tau wrapper sanity plus retained regression guard for Ask/Tau/watchdog JSON-stream monitoring obligations.

claims.proves: the Tau wrapper entrypoint runs and the current Ask/Tau/project-watchdog contracts require continuous JSON-stream monitoring for executed Tau DAGs.
claims.does_not_prove: semantic correctness, provider/model behavior, browser transport, or full Tau product readiness.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness
